title: Manipulations
subtitle: Directing the flow
text: Blood Manipulations are abilities fueled by your Blood Volume and shaped by your Tendency. Each manipulation is bound to a Vein Section (head, body, arms, or legs) and has a rank: Humilis, Mediocritas, or Summa. To learn a manipulation, you must first acquire its Hematic Memory and recall it using the Somatic Loom.
